title: Helmet of Arcane Acuity

sources.title: Battle Acuity
markers: | description = Whenever you deal damage with a weapon attack, you gain {{SmCond|Arcane Acuity}} for 2 turns.

summary: Gain +1 Dexterity saves. Deal weapon attack damage to gain 2 turns of Arcane Acuity.

fields.Arcane Acuity: +1 spell attack rolls and spell save DC per remaining turn, up to 10 turns. Taking damage removes 2 turns.
fields.Base value: 70 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Battle Acuity: Weapon damage to a creature or object grants 2 turns of Arcane Acuity. The source reports multiple applications from some multi-component attacks such as Booming Blade or smites.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
